## Description

Adapts score-based tabular Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (TabDDPM) to synthesize realistic multi-asset return trajectories while capturing non-Gaussian joint tails and volatility clustering.

## Where it may fit

Portfolio stress testing under extreme crash scenarios, training RL execution agents with high-fidelity synthetic market data.

## Vehicles

Quantitative risk management groups, systematic CTA funds, RL trading desks.

## Required data

Multivariate asset pricing, volume, and implied volatility historical panels.

## Caveats

Diffusion reverse sampling steps are computationally expensive compared to VAEs or GANs.
